scanNote:
Photo File Section, UNIT 8 ning IKKINChI varag'i. Bet raqami yo'q (varaq qirqib olinadi).

Betning yuqorisida kechqurun olingan rangli surat: suv havzasi ustidagi yog'och restoran, ichkarida stol atrofida o'tirgan odamlar, chiroqlar yonib turibdi, o'ng tomonda daraxtlar, suvda qizil-oq koi baliqlari suzib yuribdi, chapda yog'och qayiq. Surat ustida ko'k qiyshiq harflar bilan restoran nomi: 'The Blue Lagoon'.

Pastda esa YOZISh QOLIPI — gap boshlari BERILGAN, davomi bo'sh:

  'The Blue Lagoon is the .....................'
  'The food is .....................'
  'A meal for two .....................'
  'The Blue Lagoon is a .....................'

⚠ Oxirgi jumlalar TO'LIQ bosilgan:
  '... Don't miss the chance to try its various dishes, but remember to book a table first (Tel.: 6620102). Enjoy your meal.'

⚠ Bu — Unit 8 ning ikkinchi varag'i (Photo File 8-unit varag'i — rasmli matn, bu bet — yozish varag'i).

⚠ Bu varaq oldingi yozish varaqlaridan FARQ QILADI: bu yerda kitob GAP BOShLARINI bergan. Ya'ni o'quvchi bo'sh betdan emas, tayyor QOLIPdan boshlaydi.

sections.title: Photo File - Unit 8: The Blue Lagoon (write a restaurant review)
sections.titleUz: Rasmli kartalar - 8-unit: 'The Blue Lagoon' (restoran haqida taqriz yozing)

exercises.instructionEn: UNIT 8 - Look at the photo and complete the review of the restaurant.
exercises.instructionUz: 8-UNIT — Suratga qarang va restoran haqidagi taqrizni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET — YOZISh QOLIPI.

  ⚠ Oldingi yozish varaqlaridan FARQI:
  bu yerda kitob GAP BOShLARINI bergan.

  Siz bo'sh betdan emas, tayyor qolipdan
  boshlaysiz.


SURATDA NIMA:

  Kechqurun. Suv havzasi ustida qurilgan
  yog'och restoran. Ichkarida stol atrofida
  odamlar o'tirgan, chiroqlar yonyapti.
  Suvda qizil-oq KOI baliqlari suzyapti.
  O'ng tomonda daraxtlar, chapda yog'och
  qayiq.

  Restoran nomi: 'The Blue Lagoon'
     'a lagoon' = laguna (dengizdan ajralgan
                  sayoz suv havzasi)


KITOB BERGAN GAP BOShLARI:

  1  'The Blue Lagoon is the ............'
  2  'The food is ............'
  3  'A meal for two ............'
  4  'The Blue Lagoon is a ............'

  So'ng KITOBDA TO'LIQ BOSILGAN:
     '... Don't miss the chance to try its
      various dishes, but remember to book
      a table first (Tel.: 6620102).
      Enjoy your meal.'


TO'LDIRILGAN NAMUNA:

──────────────────────────────────
  The Blue Lagoon is THE BEST
  RESTAURANT IN TOWN. IT IS ON A
  SMALL LAKE AND YOU CAN SEE
  BEAUTIFUL FISH IN THE WATER.

  The food is DELICIOUS. THE MENU
  HAS GOT SOUP, FISH, CHICKEN AND
  VEGETABLES. THE FISH IS ALWAYS
  FRESH. THE WAITERS ARE FRIENDLY
  AND HELPFUL. THE MUSIC IS QUIET
  AND THE ATMOSPHERE IS ROMANTIC.

  A meal for two COSTS ABOUT $40.
  THAT IS NOT EXPENSIVE FOR SUCH A
  WONDERFUL PLACE.

  The Blue Lagoon is a GREAT PLACE
  FOR A SPECIAL EVENING.

  Don't miss the chance to try its
  various dishes, but remember to
  book a table first (Tel.: 6620102).
  Enjoy your meal.
──────────────────────────────────


TARJIMASI:

  'The Blue Lagoon — shahardagi eng yaxshi
   restoran. U kichik ko'l ustida joylashgan
   va suvda chiroyli baliqlarni ko'rasiz.

   Ovqat mazali. Menyuda sho'rva, baliq,
   tovuq va sabzavot bor. Baliq har doim
   yangi. Ofitsiantlar mehribon va
   yordamchi. Musiqa sokin, muhit romantik.

   Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 40 dollar
   turadi. Bunday ajoyib joy uchun bu qimmat
   emas.

   The Blue Lagoon — maxsus kechalar uchun
   zo'r joy.

   Uning turli taomlarini tatib ko'rish
   imkoniyatini boy bermang, lekin avval
   stol band qilishni unutmang (Tel.:
   6620102). Yoqimli ishtaha.'


⚠ TAQRIZ TUZILIShI — 4 QISM:

  1) JOY — restoran qayerda, qanaqa
  2) OVQAT va XIZMAT — mazasi, menyu,
     ofitsiantlar, muhit
  3) NARX — 'A meal for two costs ...'
  4) XULOSA + TAVSIYA


⚠ 'THE' va 'A' FARQI — MUHIM!

  Kitob ataylab ikki xil artikl bergan:

  1-gap: 'is THE ...'
     → ANIQ, YAGONA narsa
     'the BEST restaurant'
     'the MOST BEAUTIFUL place'
     ⚠ 'the' + ORTTIRMA DARAJA

  4-gap: 'is A ...'
     → NOANIQ, ko'pdan biri
     'a GREAT place'
     'a WONDERFUL restaurant'
     ⚠ 'a' + ODDIY SIFAT

  ⚠ Shuning uchun 1-gapga ORTTIRMA DARAJA,
  4-gapga ODDIY SIFAT yozing!


⚠ ORTTIRMA DARAJA (superlative):

     good  → THE BEST      (eng yaxshi)
     bad   → THE WORST     (eng yomon)
     big   → THE BIGGEST   (eng katta)
     nice  → THE NICEST    (eng yoqimli)

  UZUN sifatlar 'THE MOST' bilan:
     beautiful → THE MOST BEAUTIFUL
     expensive → THE MOST EXPENSIVE

  ⚠ 'the' HAR DOIM kerak!


⚠ 'DON'T MISS' — BUYRUQ GAPI:

  'Don't miss the chance...'
     = imkoniyatni boy bermang

  Reklama va taqrizlarda BUYRUQ GAPI ko'p:
     'Don't miss...'  — boy bermang
     'Remember to...' — unutmang
     'Enjoy...'       — rohatlaning
     'Try...'         — tatib ko'ring


⚠ 'TO BOOK A TABLE':

  'to book' = oldindan band qilmoq
     'book a table' = stol band qilmoq
     'book a room'  = xona band qilmoq

  ⚠ 'a book' (OT) = kitob —
  bir xil so'z, ikki ma'no!

  ⚠ AmE: 'to make a reservation'


⚠ 'ENJOY YOUR MEAL':

  = Yoqimli ishtaha!

  Ofitsiant ovqat keltirganda aytadi.

  ⚠ Boshqa variantlar:
     'Bon appetit!' (fransuzcha, ingliz
      tilida ham ishlatiladi)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lagoon    = laguna
  a review    = taqriz, sharh
  a dish      = taom; likobcha
  various     = turli-tuman
  to book     = band qilmoq
  a chance    = imkoniyat
  to miss     = boy bermoq; sog'inmoq
  delicious   = mazali
  fresh       = yangi (ovqat haqida)
  the menu    = menyu
  a waiter    = ofitsiant
  the atmosphere = muhit
  to cost     = turmoq (narx)
  Enjoy your meal! = Yoqimli ishtaha!

points.en: The Blue Lagoon is the best restaurant in town.
points.uz: The Blue Lagoon — shahardagi eng yaxshi restoran.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Kitob 'is THE ...' bergan — demak bu yerga
ORTTIRMA DARAJA yozish kerak.

'the best', 'the nicest', 'the most
beautiful'.

⚠ Orttirma darajada 'the' HAR DOIM kerak.

points.en: The food is delicious. The fish is always fresh.
points.uz: Ovqat mazali. Baliq har doim yangi.
points.noteUz:
Bu qismda OVQAT va XIZMAT tasvirlanadi:
menyu, ofitsiantlar, muhit.

'delicious' = mazali;
'fresh' = yangi (ovqat haqida).

⚠ 'food' va 'fish' SANALMAYDI — 'is'.

points.en: A meal for two costs about $40.
points.uz: Ikki kishilik ovqat taxminan 40 dollar turadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a meal for two' = ikki kishilik ovqat
('for two people' qisqartmasi).

'to cost' = turmoq (narx haqida).
⚠ 3-shaxs birlikda 'costS'.

'about' = taxminan.

points.en: The Blue Lagoon is a great place for a special evening.
points.uz: The Blue Lagoon — maxsus kechalar uchun zo'r joy.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu yerda kitob 'is A ...' bergan —
ORTTIRMA DARAJA EMAS, ODDIY SIFAT!

'a great place', 'a wonderful restaurant'.

⚠ 1-gapda 'the', 4-gapda 'a' — kitob buni
ATAYLAB qilgan.

points.en: Don't miss the chance to try its various dishes.
points.uz: Uning turli taomlarini tatib ko'rish imkoniyatini boy bermang.
points.noteUz:
⚠ KITOBDA TO'LIQ BOSILGAN — yozish shart
emas.

'Don't miss' — BUYRUQ GAPI (inkor).
'a chance' = imkoniyat;
'various' = turli-tuman;
'a dish' = taom.

⚠ 'its' — egalik ('it's' = 'it is' EMAS!)

points.en: Remember to book a table first (Tel.: 6620102). Enjoy your meal.
points.uz: Avval stol band qilishni unutmang (Tel.: 6620102). Yoqimli ishtaha.
points.noteUz:
'to book a table' = stol band qilmoq.
⚠ 'a book' (kitob) bilan bir xil so'z!

⚠ AmE: 'to make a reservation'.

'Enjoy your meal!' = Yoqimli ishtaha! —
ofitsiant ovqat keltirganda aytadi.
